title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. The translation, universal-Q, finite-forest, and balanced-jet continuations prove the flexible epsilon_6<gamma/6 range, the exact finite-cutoff translation/frame/Cartan identities, the universal centered derivative-square tensor in every finite moment, the 2, 4+2, 5+2, and 3+0 Wiener forests, and the full grouped rational A7 reconstruction with finite Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda retained. The strict-past and backward-heat continuations derive q=(2 epsilon_v)^-1=10/9, the full score s_j=ell_j+m_j, the retained-square/Gibbs-Pythagoras charge, and the exact raw-current reduction. A13-CLASSII-NPC-CONE-MARTINGALE-INJECTION-REDUCTION now diagonalises the production current at the Nelson exponent alpha=5/9, identifies the aggregate nonpositively curved metric cone, proves the strong nonnegative Jacobi remainder and exact raw-energy/injection telescope, falsifies shellwise raw-secant positivity at a strictly positive floor, and shows that the isolated 1:2 and 1:3 adapted resonance losses are summable. A flat CAT(0) one-shot reset model also proves that geometry and abstract one-use alone are insufficient. The sole regular-control successor is a nonlinear NPC-Carleson martingale-injection balance using the production Fourier/Cameron-Martin decay. The one-use and Nelson theorems remain open.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-TRANSLATION-UNIVERSAL-Q-BALANCED-JET-A7-RECONSTRUCTION-BACKWARD-HEAT-AND-NPC-CONE-INJECTION-REDUCTION-WITH-EXECUTED-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact non-aliased Fourier products, common bounded entrywise-real-even scalar regulators, covariance-matched A7 Wick subtraction, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The latest theorem is finite-cutoff and applies to bounded cylindrical, or otherwise sufficiently integrable, strict-past controls with one mutually orthogonal control block per sharp shell. Its metric-cone statement uses the standard angle-clipped completion of the regular radial target. It does not cover a progressive flow that revisits a Fourier range or establish the nonlinear NPC-Carleson injection balance or the localization/lower-semicontinuity extension to every finite-energy drift. The one-use theorem and umbrella gate remain open.
falsifier: A failure of any prior A13 Fierz, source, factor-four, determinant, translation/frame, Cartan, universal-Q, forest, balanced-jet, strict-past, or backward-heat assertion remains a falsifier for its package. The latest continuation is falsified by a production coefficient ratio different from alpha=5/9, q different from 10/9, failure of the exact current factorisation or aggregate cone metric, positive smooth cone curvature or a failed CAT(1) base diagnostic, a wrong sign in the strong Jacobi remainder or raw-energy/injection telescope, loss of strict positivity in the registered witness interpolation, a nonnegative full production witness secant, nonsummable isolated 1:2 or 1:3 completed losses at the proved shell powers, misclassification of the flat model as a production counterexample, application beyond regular one-shot controls, a source/PDF hash mismatch, a failed 24/24 primary, 23/23 independent, 118/118 integrated, nine-page PDF, or release assertion.

reproduction.expected: Primary 24/24, non-importing independent 23/23, and integrated 118/118 aggregate PASS sentinel; exit 0.

no_overclaim: The latest theorem is an exact/analytic reduction for regular mutually orthogonal one-shot strict-past controls. It does not prove the nonlinear NPC-Carleson martingale-injection balance, the extension to every finite-energy drift, the controlled-shell one-use inequality, the q=10/9 Nelson moment, an interacting measure, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7. The flat CAT(0) reset model is not a production counterexample.
next_action: Continue under A13-CLASSII-NPC-CONE-MARTINGALE-INJECTION-BALANCE. For every zeta,eta>0, prove uniformly in J that the expected sum of the signed geodesic first variations plus the nonnegative Jacobi remainders is bounded below by -zeta E||Z_J||_6^6-eta E sum_j||h_j||^2-C. The estimate must control causally harvestable raw-energy injection through production Fourier/Cameron-Martin decay and an A12-compatible nonlinear Carleson or paradifferential argument. Geodesic logarithms spread Fourier support, while affine physical interpolation loses the Jacobi sign; neither shellwise positivity nor a geometry-only one-shot argument is admissible. Then establish localization/lower semicontinuity for the declared finite-energy class before invoking one-use.
notes: Scoped T4 exact/analytic reduction plus executed architecture no-gos. The latest package proves the Nelson-aligned current factorisation, aggregate NPC cone, strong Jacobi remainder, exact raw-energy/injection telescope, positive-floor shellwise-negativity witness, and summability of the isolated 1:2 and 1:3 adapted resonance losses. A flat CAT(0) reset model proves that geometry plus abstract one-use is insufficient without production target-coupling decay. Primary 24/24, non-importing independent 23/23, and integrated 118/118 aggregate assertions pass. The nine-page PDF passes form, zero-overfull, and direct all-page visual QA. T-050 remains in progress at the nonlinear NPC-Carleson martingale-injection balance and finite-energy extension. Tier stays T4.
